baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic negated entry verb, its feminine object, the adversative-sounding عَلَيْكُم, and the singled-out مِسْكِين.
baseline_models.mechanism: A speaking collective closes the threshold of an enclosed referent and casts one needy entrant's movement inward as movement against the collective. The clause does not merely predict absence; it voices an access-control rule backed by group solidarity.

activation_trace.role: Literal going inside supplies the threshold-crossing event that the emphatic prohibition closes.
The image of an entrant mixed into a group sharpens عَلَيْكُم into an in-group treating the arrival as intrusion.
Poverty, weakness, and abasement identify the barred entrant as someone already lacking leverage, making the boundary asymmetrical.

changed_reading.before: A poor person simply will not arrive at an unspecified place.
changed_reading.after: A collective actively converts a place or resource into guarded inside-space and treats the needy entrant as an incursion upon itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic prohibition is pinned to ٱلْيَوْمَ rather than stated as an unrestricted rule.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ordinary bounded day makes exclusion tactical: the speakers need the threshold closed during one decisive operating window. The event-day branch remains co-present, letting 'today' sound like both a calendar interval and the occasion on which control must be secured.

activation_trace.role: Going inside supplies the event whose completion is prevented during the selected interval.
The sunrise-to-sunset day gives the ban a finite, operational window.
The severe occasion or event-day image raises the window from routine timekeeping to a decisive affair.

changed_reading.before: The sentence expresses a timeless social aversion.
changed_reading.after: The sentence is a time-boxed embargo whose success depends on controlling access on one decisive day.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The motion verb يَدْخُلَنَّهَا is negated precisely for the person named مِسْكِين.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus juxtaposes attempted inward motion with a noun whose root inventory includes cessation of motion as well as poverty. The ban can therefore be heard as socially productive, not merely descriptive: it keeps the already weakened person stationary at the threshold.

activation_trace.role: Entry contributes the interrupted inward motion.
Cessation of motion turns the threshold command into an imposed stopping of the person.
Poverty and humble weakness make that imposed stillness a social condition rather than neutral physical rest.

changed_reading.before: Poverty is a fixed trait of the person who happens to be excluded.
changed_reading.after: Exclusion helps reproduce miskin-like immobility by stopping a weak person's movement toward the resource.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus root that carries literal entry also carries what comes into an estate as income, while مِسْكِين carries both need and provision that permits staying.
baseline_models.mechanism: A cross-domain reading overlays two inward movements: a person enters the enclosure, and gain enters the holders' estate. Barring the needy person closes the second movement's distributive outlet, so incoming yield remains a private loop instead of becoming provision that stabilizes another life.

activation_trace.role: The form-distant image of income or what comes in supplies the resource inflow that the speakers seek to retain.
Provision that enables staying supplies the distributive use denied when need is kept outside.
Poverty and weakness identify the human endpoint from which the incoming gain is withheld.

changed_reading.before: The clause regulates only a person's physical entrance.
changed_reading.after: The clause also sketches a closed revenue circuit: what comes in for the holders must not flow outward as stabilizing provision for need.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier image of an extension not cut short, alongside release without counterpayment, activates an economy opposite to the focus embargo. The focus can now be heard as an attempt to cut the continuation of benefit at the exact point where it might reach need.

activation_trace.role: Income or what comes in supplies the benefit flow whose onward continuation is contested.
Provision enabling continued residence supplies the life-sustaining endpoint of that flow.
Cutting and diminution until an extension ends supply the negative economic motion enacted by the no-entry order.
Release without compensation supplies the contrasting possibility of benefit not enclosed by exchange or repayment.

structural_cues: 68:3 places the مَمْنُون image before the focus narrative, allowing its opposed branch possibilities to remain active when access is later closed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cutting-off and release-without-return under م ن ن plus the focus income/provision branches; I infer a contrast between continuing gift and interrupted distribution. A live alternative is that 68:3 concerns only the addressee's reward and offers no economic analogy to 68:24.

changed_reading.before: The speakers preserve a spatial boundary.
changed_reading.after: They attempt to terminate a benefit stream just before it can become unreciprocated provision for someone in need.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior portrait of intensified prevention of good supplies both hand-withholding and barrier-building. The focus clause becomes a concrete enactment of that profile: a physical entrance ban is the means by which generosity is stopped.

activation_trace.role: Literal entry supplies the route that is closed.
Poverty and weakness identify the person from whom useful giving is withheld.
The hand held back from giving turns the entry restriction into withheld beneficence.
A barrier between a person and what is sought supplies the exact social architecture of the focus prohibition.
Generosity and gift identify the good that threshold control prevents from reaching the poor person.

structural_cues: 68:12 couples intensified prevention directly with good before the garden sequence supplies the focus example.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a preventer-of-good portrait and branch images of a withheld hand, a barrier, and gift; I infer that 68:24 instantiates the portrait through access control. A live alternative is that the portrait and garden speakers are only analogous, not narratively identical.

changed_reading.before: The ban could be prudent control of a private threshold.
changed_reading.after: The ban is a mechanism for preventing good: spatial control operationalizes refusal to give.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath inventory also carries partitioning a thing into shares, while the next cue carries excluding an item from a whole. Their failure to except and their no-entry clause jointly activate a distributive reading: the poor person's allotted portion is deliberately set to zero before the day begins.

activation_trace.role: Entry supplies the physical condition through which a claimant might reach a share.
The bounded day turns the partition into a prearranged distribution plan for that morning.
Poverty identifies the person assigned no access and thus no portion.
Partitioning and separating a share turns the oath into advance allocation, with exclusion functioning as a zero share.
The divided oath binds the collective to its allocation plan.
Excluding something from a whole supplies the missing carve-out that could have interrupted total appropriation.

structural_cues: The packet orders oath and intended cutting in 68:17, non-exception in 68:18, and the explicit exclusion clause in 68:24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath/partition and exception/exclusion branch images; I infer that the spoken ban implements a zero-share allocation. A live alternative is that 68:18 concerns only failure to qualify the oath by divine permission, not failure to reserve a social share.

changed_reading.before: The poor person is denied physical presence.
changed_reading.after: Physical non-entry is the enforcement layer of a prior distributive decision: the poor person's share has been calculated as nothing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers imagine control at an entry point, but the earlier visitation is imaged as circling and even encompassing the whole referent. The decisive agency is not a needy entrant approaching their gate; it can surround the protected inside while they are unavailable, making the guarded threshold strategically irrelevant.

activation_trace.role: Going inside supplies the gate-centered model of control that the context overturns.
Circling around a thing supplies motion that reaches the protected referent without submitting to the speakers' entry rule.
The encompassing flood image scales the visitation from a gate crossing to total perimeter capture.

structural_cues: 68:19 places the encompassing visitation while the group sleeps; 68:24 records their later confidence in controlling who can enter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal entry and circling/encompassing images; I infer a spatial irony in which perimeter-scale agency outflanks gatekeeping. A live alternative is that طائف merely names a transient affliction and contributes no route geometry.

changed_reading.before: The speakers can secure the resource by policing its entrance.
changed_reading.after: Their gate policy exposes a category error: the force that decides possession can envelop the whole perimeter and need not enter on their terms.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lowered speech coordinates a collective embargo; prevention and contraction give it a withholding posture; capability and narrowing convert that posture into controlled scarcity. The focus sentence is thus not a passing prejudice but the quiet operating instruction by which power keeps provision concentrated.

activation_trace.role: Entry is the controllable operation named by the whispered instruction.
Provision that permits staying identifies what concentrated control keeps from stabilizing another household.
Secret, lowered speech makes the focus clause a coordinated instruction concealed from the person it targets.
Prevention and contraction supply the collective posture that carries the no-entry command into action.
Cutoff of milk or rain supplies a material image for stopping a sustaining flow at its source.
Effective capability supplies the power needed to enforce the exclusion rather than merely wish for it.
Narrowing something to a small measure supplies the scarcity-producing result of that power.

structural_cues: The packet runs from covert group speech in 68:23 through the focus instruction to purposeful capability in 68:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies whispering, prevention, cutoff, capability, and narrowing; I infer a causal chain from covert coordination to enforced scarcity. A live alternative is that حرد means only intent or anger and قدر only confidence, leaving scarcity as result rather than deliberate technique.

changed_reading.before: One sentence expresses a momentary desire to avoid a visitor.
changed_reading.after: The sentence is the command layer of a coordinated scarcity machine: secrecy, solidarity, and capacity are aligned to keep sustaining flow concentrated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The group first experiences the desired object as lost, then names itself deprived. Their intended subject-object relation reverses: those who planned to bar the poor person from access become the people from whom the sought good is barred.

activation_trace.role: Entry supplies the access relation whose controlling side changes.
Need and weakness supply the social position into which the confident holders partially fall.
Loss of the sought thing dissolves the group's assumed mastery of route and object.
Prevention and prohibition return the group's own exclusionary action as a condition imposed on them.
Deprivation and failure to obtain the desired thing explicitly relocate lack from the poor entrant to the holders.

structural_cues: 68:26 and 68:27 preserve the group's self-correction from being lost to being deprived immediately after its access plan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the planned entry ban followed by loss and self-named deprivation; I infer a reciprocal reversal of access roles. A live alternative is that crop loss makes the group deprived only episodically and does not place it in the poor person's broader social condition.

changed_reading.before: The poor person alone occupies the outside, deprived position.
changed_reading.after: The clause stages a reversible relation: the gatekeepers' attempt to assign deprivation returns as their own inability to reach what they claimed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The best or just middle voice interrupts the collective, and the later confession carries a branch image of withholding or imprisoning a right. The poor person's entry is consequently reclassified from optional tolerance to the route of a claim whose obstruction is ظلم.

activation_trace.role: Entry is the concrete route through which the contested claim would be exercised.
Poverty and weakness locate the claim with the person least able to force recognition.
Justice and the best position at the middle supply the internal countervoice against the group's extreme closure.
Exonerating and declaring transcendence opens a standard outside the owners' self-authorizing calculation.
Withholding and confining a right gives the confession a precise distributive object in the blocked access of the poor.

structural_cues: 68:28 isolates one corrective voice from within the group; 68:29 turns the group's speech from exclusion to self-accusation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a just/best middle, exoneration, and ظلم as withholding a right; I infer that the focus access is one such right-bearing route. A live alternative is that their wrongdoing lies only in failing to qualify the oath or acknowledge the Lord, with no specific distributive entitlement inferred for the poor person.

changed_reading.before: Entry would be a discretionary favor granted by possessors.
changed_reading.after: Entry becomes the practical route of a weak claimant's right, so blocking the threshold is an act of withholding rather than mere non-generosity.

context_deltas.mechanism: After deprivation, replacement, gift-like good, and redirected desire loosen the possessive closure encoded by 'it' and 'upon you.' The resource becomes exchangeable provision rather than an absolute extension of the holders, exposing the no-entry order as dependence disguised as ownership.

activation_trace.role: What comes into an estate as income supplies the falsely self-contained possession.
Provision enabling residence supplies the alternative view of yield as received sustenance rather than absolute property.
One thing standing in place of another makes the supposedly fixed possession replaceable.
Generosity and gift recast the hoped-for better object as received good rather than self-generated entitlement.
Desire turning toward or away from an object redirects attachment from the lost enclosure toward its giver.

structural_cues: 68:32 follows the self-recognition of deprivation and changes the group's grammar from control of the object to hope for replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies replacement, gift, redirected desire, income, and provision; I infer that the resource's status shifts from absolute possession to revocable provision. A live alternative is that 68:32 expresses only a wish for a superior replacement and leaves the group's property concept unchanged.

changed_reading.before: The barred referent is an asset naturally continuous with the speakers' collective self.
changed_reading.after: The asset is contingent and replaceable provision; treating a needy entrant as an attack 'upon you' mistakes received good for sovereign identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later interrogative sequence challenges judgment, binding inscription, and oaths reaching an event-day. Against that sequence, the focus sounds like a self-authored one-day statute: the collective legislates who may enter and assumes its oath can make that allocation binding.

activation_trace.role: Literal entry supplies the conduct regulated by the collective's private rule.
The event-day image lets the focus اليوم function as the jurisdictional term of the speakers' decree.
Judgment between people exposes the no-entry order as a ruling about another person's standing.
An inscription that establishes an obligation or decree supplies the absent authorization the speakers act as though they possess.
The oath image supplies the claimed binding force behind the collective plan.
The severe event-day extends the question from a private 'today' to the day on which presumed guarantees are tested.

structural_cues: 68:36-40 repeatedly asks what authorizes the audience's judgment, choice, oath, and guarantee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judgment, decree-making inscription, oath, and event-day images; I infer that the focus imperative performs unauthorized private legislation. A live alternative is that the later questions address a broader audience and only structurally echo the garden group's plan.

changed_reading.before: The clause is logistical coordination for one morning.
changed_reading.after: The collective turns logistics into private law, claiming authority to define a needy person's status and access for its chosen day.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who voice a ban against an abased person's inward movement are later imaged as called toward an act of abasement but unable to perform it, after which abasement covers them. Agency over access and lowliness reverses: the gatekeeper cannot answer a summons, and the condition assigned to the poor reaches the powerful.

activation_trace.role: Entry supplies the first access event, controlled by the speaking collective.
Humble abasement supplies the low social position initially attached to the barred person.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies a later invitation whose addressees cannot answer bodily.
Capacity to perform an act, here negated in context, removes the agency the gatekeepers earlier assumed.
Lowering and abasement make the requested destination a posture resembling the lowliness projected onto the miskin.
Broken abasement under overpowering force relocates lowliness onto those who cannot answer the call.

structural_cues: 68:42-43 move in sequence from summons, to incapacity, to overtaking abasement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies barred entry, a later summons, negated capacity, prostrating abasement, and imposed humiliation; I infer a reciprocal access pattern. A live alternative is that the later scene concerns deniers generally and does not specifically answer the garden speakers' treatment of the poor.

changed_reading.before: The collective permanently owns agency, while the poor person permanently owns lowliness.
changed_reading.after: Agency and abasement are reversible positions: the one who bars another's movement can become unable to answer a call and be overtaken by the lowliness once assigned outside.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the attached-outsider image in 68:13 describes a different portrait, not the poor person. It remains valid as a social-boundary activation because the focus entry root itself includes an outsider mixed into a group and عَلَيْكُم polarizes group against entrant. Downstream prose should present it as an analogy for manufactured outsiderhood, never as an identification of the miskin with the earlier figure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The barred inward motion, the collective عَلَيْكُم, and the poor entrant's relation to an inside group.

activation_trace.role: The outsider mixed into a group anchors the possibility that entry is policed as social membership, not only location.
Poverty and weakness identify the person vulnerable to being assigned outsider status.
A person attached onto a group supplies the stigmatizing social image through which the speakers can construe a needy entrant as not properly belonging.

changed_reading.before: Need alone explains why the person is excluded.
changed_reading.after: The collective may manufacture need into outsiderhood, treating the poor person's presence as improper attachment to the in-group.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a branch-level resonance across ص ر م and ج ر م, not an etymological identity, so it is deliberately odd. It remains anchored because the focus exclusion determines what kind of harvest the planned cutting becomes: gain secured by barring need. Downstream prose should call it a moral sound-and-image activation, not claim that every harvest is criminal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The no-entry order for the poor is the distributive condition attached to the planned acquisition of yield.

activation_trace.role: Income or what comes into an estate anchors the economic result sought through exclusion.
Poverty supplies the excluded claim that changes the moral valence of acquisition.
Cutting date fruit supplies the ordinary harvest action whose distributive condition is named in the focus.
Cutting and severing echo the harvest operation across the later criminal-category root.
Crime and offense supply the moral reclassification activated when cutting is coupled to exclusion of the poor.

changed_reading.before: Harvesting and excluding are adjacent but separable actions.
changed_reading.after: The exclusion clause is the switch by which ordinary cutting for gain resonates as criminal severing of a social claim.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-root counter-entry is surprising because 68:44 addresses a broader denying audience and does not explicitly say the garden group enters anything. It remains anchored in the focus entry verb, while the context branches supply gradual taking and insertion into a cover. Downstream prose should render it as structural irony, not narrative coreference.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The collective's confidence that it controls who goes inside.

activation_trace.role: Literal entry anchors the reversal from controlling another's inward movement to undergoing an unseen one.
The hidden interior supplies the destination concealed from those who believe they control the visible threshold.
Being taken degree by degree supplies the slow counter-movement into consequences.
Folding and inserting into a covering gives that counter-movement an inward, concealed geometry.

changed_reading.before: The speakers stand outside the entry event as its sovereign controllers.
changed_reading.after: While forbidding one visible entrant, they may themselves be moving step by step into a hidden interior of consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 68:46 rhetorically denies that another audience is burdened by a demanded payment; it does not define the miskin's biography. It remains anchored through the focus root's stillness and poverty branches, while debt and load supply a plausible material cause of immobilization. Downstream prose should present debt as an abductive analogy for produced need, not a lexical gloss of مِسْكِين.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The poor person's root-linked weakness and stopped movement at the threshold.

activation_trace.role: Cessation of motion supplies the immobilized condition to be materially explained.
Poverty and weakness identify the social state associated with that immobility.
A financial liability that clings supplies a material pressure capable of producing constrained movement.
Being loaded with a burden supplies the downward force that turns lack into practical immobility.

changed_reading.before: The miskin is statically categorized as poor before reaching the gate.
changed_reading.after: The miskin can be read as someone made unable to move by adhering burdens, with exclusion adding another load rather than merely observing a status.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the exposed castaway sequence belongs to the fish-companion account, not the garden, and the foundling branch is image-distant. It remains anchored through the focus contrast between entering a settled interior and leaving a weak person outside, while grace supplies the live reversal of abandonment. Downstream prose should use it as a hospitality analogy and not identify the poor entrant with that narrative figure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The poor person is denied movement into an inside that could provide settlement and comfort.

activation_trace.role: The outsider seeking mixture with an inside group anchors the hospitality boundary.
Dwelling and settlement supply the sheltering inside denied by the prohibition.
An object of rest and comfort supplies the human value of admission beyond access to goods.
The cast-away child supplies an extreme image of a vulnerable person assigned to the outside.
Open unsheltered ground gives spatial form to what exclusion from dwelling can produce.
Being left neglected and unsupported supplies the social consequence of keeping the weak entrant outside.
Good condition and grace supply the counterforce that reaches and restores the exposed rather than sealing the inside.

changed_reading.before: The no-entry clause protects an interior from an unwanted visitor.
changed_reading.after: The clause risks producing a castaway outside shelter, while the later grace image preserves the competing possibility that exposed need is reached rather than abandoned.

strongest_changes: The physical gate became the enforcement layer of preventing good and assigning the poor person a zero share.
Whispering, prevention, cutoff, capability, and narrowing turned the sentence into a coordinated scarcity operation rather than a private dislike.
Loss and self-named deprivation reversed the access relation, placing the intended gatekeepers on the barred side of their own logic.
The just middle voice and ظلم-as-withheld-right changed entry from discretionary favor into the route of a claim.
Later questions about judgment, inscription, oath, and event-day exposed the focus command as unauthorized private law.
summary.what_was_special: The focus clause held several mechanisms at once: guarded social inside, one-day embargo, imposed immobility, closed revenue flow, zero-share partition, and reversible deprivation. The most productive surprise was that entry was not only spatial; it became the hinge connecting distribution, status, authority, and the later loss of agency.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-exception cue may concern divine qualification alone rather than a reserved social share, though both remain live.
The income and provision branches are form-distant overlays and should not displace the literal entry and poverty senses.
The later judgment, prostration, gradual-taking, debt, and castaway scenes may structurally answer the focus without referring to the garden group specifically.
The cutting-to-criminality resonance is abductive sound-and-image patterning, not an etymological equation.
